messages:
andrea: Heads up — PR #432 (docs/site/guides/serving.md) is stuck. CI docs-preview failed and we need an API behavior confirmation about default model caching & retry behaviour before we can merge. pinging eng.
maria: Link to the PR?
andrea: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432. Preview job shows: 'linkcheck: unresolved reference /api/defaults' in the logs.
deploy-bot: docs-preview failed — log excerpt: 'Error: unresolved reference: /api/defaults in serving.md line 42'
sam: We can't merge until we confirm defaults for cache_enabled and streaming. The docs currently state cache_enabled: true globally — is that correct for Private deployments?
kevin: On it. Quick answer:
- Hosted API default: cache_enabled = true.
- Private deployments: cache_enabled = false by default unless you set runtime.cache.default = true in the private config.
- Streaming default: false for the sync /generate endpoints; streaming is served via the separate streams endpoints (/v1/streams).
andrea: Can you paste the authoritative config snippet so I can update the docs and rerun linkcheck?
kevin: Sure — internal API spec snippet to copy into the docs:
```
# runtime defaults
cache_enabled: true  # hosted only
streaming: false
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 2
  backoff_ms: 200
```
Also note: Dedicated deployments support a per-deployment override (deployment.config.cache_defaults) — I'll add a sentence about that.
maria: Thanks. Kevin — is retry behaviour a client SDK default or server-side? The current docs claim SDK retries 3x which conflicts with server settings.
kevin: Good catch. Reality:
- Server enforces 2 automatic retries for transient 5xx errors.
- SDKs implement client-side idempotent retries for non-streaming requests; JS SDK default is 1 client retry.
So effective default is server 2 + SDK 1 unless the client disables SDK retries. I'll write this up so docs are explicit.
sam: Perfect. If Andrea updates the front matter and text, can someone trigger a manual docs-preview? Our CI doesn't run on PRs from forks automatically.
andrea: I'll push an update in ~10m. I'll also move the /api/defaults anchor into the reference section so linkcheck can find it.
docs-bot: Preview requested: https://deploy-preview-432--docs.redwood-inference.com — status: pending
deploy-bot: Preview failed: linkcheck still failing at line 54: unresolved reference 'dedicated-overrides'
kevin: That's on me — I forgot to add the anchor. I'll add a short 'Dedicated overrides' subsection with the anchor `#dedicated-overrides` in serving.md.
andrea: Updated PR with both the caching/retry clarifications and the dedicated-overrides anchor. PTAL @kevin @sam. CI retriggered.
docs-bot: Preview requested: https://deploy-preview-432--docs.redwood-inference.com — status: success :tada:
sam: LGTM. I'll merge after a quick spellcheck run. ETA 30m.
maria: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!
